title: 전문심리위원규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:2:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2-2 (Commissioning Full-Time Expert Commissioners, etc.)
(1) The Minister of the National Court Administration may commission full-time expert commissioners to perform the duties of expert commissioners under the Civil Procedure Act. <Amended on November 29, 2024.>
(2) The period of commission of a full-time expert commissioner shall be two years, and the commissioner may be re-commissioned.
(3) A full-time expert commissioner shall not concurrently engage in another occupation for profit without permission from the Minister of the National Court Administration.
(4) Where deemed necessary for efficient performance of the duties of a full-time expert commissioner, the Minister of the National Court Administration may have the president of a high court or district court provide the commissioner with offices or other physical facilities necessary for performing the duties.
(5) Where a full-time expert commissioner participates in litigation proceedings, the court shall periodically evaluate the appropriateness of the duties performed by the commissioner at least once a year.
